title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Answer
moral: Helping others is the most important duty.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about an honest boy.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a boy who always spoke the truth.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The king asked the boy who was the most important person.
scenes.image_prompt: king asking question to boy cartoon

scenes.text: The boy thought and gave a thoughtful answer.
scenes.image_prompt: boy thinking and answering confidently cartoon

scenes.summary: The boy gives a wise answer.
scenes.text: The boy said the most important person is the one who needs help.
scenes.image_prompt: boy explaining answer to king cartoon

scenes.text: The king praised and rewarded the boy. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding boy while smiling cartoon

story: A boy answered the king wisely by saying the most important person is the one who needs help. The king rewarded him. Vikram said it showed kindness and honesty.
